name: Pre-Release Validation
description: Full pre-release readiness. All items must pass before release.

items.check: Is Game.php under 300 lines with zero SQL and zero domain logic?
items.pass: Game.php is a thin coordinator under 300 lines
items.fail: Game.php exceeds 300 lines, contains SQL, or has domain logic
items.fix: Extract domain logic into Managers. Extract SQL into Manager methods. Game.php retains only delegation.

items.check: Does every Manager own one aggregate root with exclusive write ownership?
items.pass: All Managers own one aggregate root with no cross-writes
items.fail: A Manager writes to another Manager's table or calls another Manager directly
items.fix: Move writes to the owning Manager. Replace cross-Manager calls with action mediation per ARCH-014.

items.check: Does every non-GAME state have a zombie handler? Is giveExtraTime on every turn transition?
items.pass: All non-GAME states have zombie handlers and giveExtraTime is wired
items.fail: A non-GAME state lacks zombie handling or giveExtraTime is missing
items.fix: Add zombie() to every non-GAME state per STAT-009 and STAT-010. Wire giveExtraTime in onEnteringState per STAT-011.

items.check: Do all game tables use InnoDB with FK constraints and atomic conditional UPDATEs?
items.pass: All tables use InnoDB with FK and atomic UPDATE patterns
items.fail: A table uses MyISAM, lacks FK, or uses non-conditional UPDATE
items.fix: Change ENGINE to InnoDB. Add FK constraints. Use WHERE with expected state for all UPDATEs.

items.check: Is every action handler under 15 lines with five ordered responsibilities?
items.pass: All action handlers are under 15 lines with correct structure
items.fail: An action handler exceeds 15 lines or misorders responsibilities
items.fix: Extract validation into Manager::validate*. Ensure five ordered responsibilities per ACTN-002.

items.check: Are all notifications sent through a centralized Notifications class?
items.pass: All notifications go through the centralized Notifications class
items.fail: A notifyAllPlayers call exists outside the Notifications class
items.fix: Wrap the external call in a Notifications static method. Remove the direct framework call.

items.check: Are all client notification handlers registered in setupPromiseNotifications and idempotent?
items.pass: All handlers are registered and idempotent
items.fail: A handler is not registered or is not idempotent
items.fix: Register in setupPromiseNotifications with notif_<camelCase> naming. Ensure idempotent DOM updates.

items.check: Does getAllDatas delegate to every Manager? Are refreshUI and refreshHand wired?
items.pass: Reconnect path delegates with refreshUI and refreshHand
items.fail: getAllDatas does not delegate or refreshUI/refreshHand are missing
items.fix: Implement getAllDatas delegation per SYNC-001. Wire refreshUI for public state and refreshHand per SYNC-002.

items.check: Does every mutation record old values? Does undo reverse in LIFO order?
items.pass: All mutations are undoable with logged values and LIFO reversal
items.fail: A mutation lacks old-value logging or undo is not LIFO
items.fix: Add old-value logging before every state mutation. Verify LIFO order within checkpoint boundaries.

items.check: Do Manager methods, scoring functions, and unique abilities have dedicated tests?
items.pass: Test coverage meets requirements for Managers, scoring, and abilities
items.fail: A Manager method, scoring function, or unique ability lacks a test
items.fix: Add Manager unit tests per TEST-002. Add scoring tests per TEST-003. Add ability tests per TEST-004.

items.check: Is hidden information protected in all notification paths, state args, and error messages?
items.fail: Hidden information is exposed in a public path
items.fix: Audit all notification payloads. Split into public/private pairs. Spectators and non-participants must never receive private state.
